brief.zh: 校准板上有四个不同亮度的圆点。调整亮度阈值，观察哪些圆点会保留下来。
brief.en: Four dots on the calibration board have different brightness levels. Adjust the threshold and see which dots remain.

concept.zh: OpenCV 把比阈值亮的像素变成白色，其余像素变成黑色，再数出连在一起的白色区域。
concept.en: OpenCV turns pixels brighter than the threshold white and the rest black, then counts the connected white regions.

hints.zh: 从 115 提高到 180，看保留的区域和白色像素数怎么变。
hints.en: Raise the threshold from 115 to 180. Compare the number of regions and white pixels.

prompt.zh: 改变阈值，比较输入图片和得到的黑白图。再选 7 × 7 模糊，检查白色区域边缘和像素数。
prompt.en: Change the threshold and compare the original board with the mask. Then try 7 × 7 blur and check the mask edges and white pixel count.
